assets.name: workbench-v2
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game full-screen background, 16:9 landscape 2048x1152 or larger. An ENTIRE realistic electronics assembly workbench seen exactly from overhead, in the premium anime naval technology style of Azur Lane Eagle Union. A continuous midnight-blue anti-static cutting mat on a brushed silver metal desk; crisp fine copper circuit tracks and understated cyan instrument lights. A broad clean central working area and broad clean left and right areas for gameplay overlay. Around the outermost perimeter only: soldering iron dock, precision tweezers, oscilloscope fragments, reels of copper wire, a few spare integrated circuits, red-white naval insignia stickers, tiny wing-star mark. Material authenticity: sharp metal edges, dark ceramic, realistic tool materials, very subtle soft shadows. No interface panels, no window border frame, no UI, no labels, no text, no letters, no numbers, no characters, no watermark. It must read as one physical worktable, not a sci-fi app dashboard. Central 85 percent restrained and uncluttered so real game components can be placed over it. Color palette midnight navy, brushed silver, cyan circuit lights, warm gold contacts and restrained red accents. Flat orthographic composition, no perspective tilt, no blur.
